title: A-A pair at rest, separation 3 to 9: piecewise-linear K(r) table at P = 2.5, supersedes P-0003

claims.statement: Two A particles at rest, initial separation r0 in [3.0, 9.0]: each accelerates toward the other with magnitude K(r) / r^2.5, r the current separation, where K(r) is linear between the nodes K = 17.683 (r = 3), 17.701 (4), 17.834 (5), 16.617 (6), 15.121 (7), 13.432 (8), 11.624 (9). Measured positions are predicted to a judged RMSE of 0.007 of the chamber side for durations up to 1.5 when r0 < 5, 2.0 when 5 <= r0 < 7, and 3.0 when r0 >= 7. K is not constant over the range: it is flat to 5 and falls by 35% from 5 to 9, so the constant-K claim P-0003 is superseded. The claim is for A-A only, two particles, at rest, and states K(r) at exponent 2.5 only. It says nothing about other exponents or shapes, separations outside [3, 9], other species, or more particles.
